arguments.content:
Incident Summary

Date: [Insert Date]
Duration: {{int:20:30}} minutes
Affected Service: Login Service
Root Cause: Expired SSL/TLS certificate

What happened?
Our monitoring systems detected that the login service became unavailable at [Insert Time]. Investigation revealed that the SSL/TLS certificate used by the service had expired, causing authentication requests to be rejected.

Impact:
- Users were unable to log in to the portal for approximately {{int:20:30}} minutes.
- All login attempts during this period resulted in error messages.

Resolution:
- The expired certificate was promptly replaced with a valid one.
- The login service was restarted, restoring normal operation.
- Post‑incident checks confirmed that the service was fully functional.

Preventive Measures:
- Implemented automated certificate monitoring and renewal processes.
- Added alerts for upcoming certificate expirations.
- Updated operational runbooks to include rapid certificate replacement steps.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

If you have any further questions, please contact our support team.
